intent: Implement the Phase 5 evidence-based skill learning core on an isolated branch while preserving the Phase 3 and Phase 4 integration boundaries.

findings.title: Capability constraints were escapable through globalThis and asynchronous callbacks
Telemetry retries could accept a changed immutable payload
Retention watermark could drop late events with older timestamps
Generic lifecycle transitions could bypass privileged promotion and supersession policy
Production learned-skill binding awaits the Phase 3 frozen turn bundle
Automatic quarantine index publication awaits immutable index generations
Phase 5 end-to-end failure matrix and 100k benchmark remain outstanding

residual_actionable_work: Wire the frozen per-turn learned-skill bundle after mini-agent-dqf lands.
Publish quarantine and privacy removals into the immutable in-memory index after mini-agent-af7.1 lands.
Run the Phase 5 audit, failure matrix, and 100k-event benchmark after Phases 3 and 4 merge.
advisory_outputs: The parallel Phase 4 worktree was not read or modified.
Phase 4 store-schema changes may require a deliberate rebase resolution.
Phase 5 child issues remain in progress because their production acceptance criteria depend on open Phase 3 and Phase 4 issues.
verdict: Core implementation validated; Phase 5 exit blocked on Phases 3 and 4
